html:
Your space, your rules. This video from Treble Technologies shows a walk through a virtual scene in which the user can adjust sound levels in the space in real time and change its structure and materials. Room-acoustic simulation and spatial audio algorithms then render realistic 3D sound for playback.

The point is to let future users and decision-makers both see and hear a building before it is built, so that the experience can guide the design.

Video: Treble Technologies, shared by Fanyu Meng on Ziyu Acoustics.
